title: Fix AppSource product details opening in write transactions
summary: AppSource Product Details page now opens non-modally to prevent write transaction errors that occur when user settings initialization happens before the modal invocation.
key_points: Changed from Page.RunModal() to Page.Run() to avoid write transaction conflicts
Fixes error when opening AppSource Product Details with pending writes
Caller does not consume modal result, making non-modal navigation safe
Added regression test coverage for normal and write-transacted scenarios
